blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. O God, come to my assistance.//\R. O Lord, make haste to help me.
Glory be...

Your saints, O Lord,//shall flourish like the lily, alleluia;
and like the fragrance of balsam//they shall be before you, alleluia.

blocks.text:
1. Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo:
    All sit Sede a dextris meis:
  2. Donec ponam inimícos tuos, scabéllum pedum tuórum.
  3. Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.

  4. Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
  5. Jurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
  6. Dóminus a dextris tuis, confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
  7. Judicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.
  8. De torrénte in via bibet: proptérea exaltábit caput.
  9. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
  10. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right hand,
  2. until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.
  3. The Lord will send forth from Sion the sceptre of your power: rule in the midst of your enemies.



  4. With you is princely rule on the day of your strength, amid the splendours of the saints: from the womb, before the morning star, I begot you.
  5. The Lord has sworn, and he will not repent: You are a priest for ever according to the order of Melchizedek.
  6. The Lord at your right hand has crushed kings in the day of his wrath.
  7. He will judge among the nations; he will fill ruins: he will shatter heads in many lands.
  8. He will drink from the torrent on the way: therefore he will lift up his head.
  9. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation:
Your saints, O Lord,//shall flourish like the lily, alleluia;
and like the fragrance of balsam//they shall be before you, alleluia.

In the heavenly realms//is the dwelling of the saints, alleluia;
and their rest is for ever, alleluia.
_Ps. 110_  I will give thanks to you,//O Lord, with my whole heart: in the council of the just and in the assembly.

blocks.text:
1. Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.

  2. Conféssio et magnificéntia opus eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
  3. Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, † miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * escam dedit timéntibus se.
  4. Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:
  5. Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum eius véritas, et iudícium.
  6. Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: † confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.
  7. Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: * mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
  8. Sanctum, et terríbile nomen eius: * inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.
  9. Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: * laudátio eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
  10. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  11. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. Great are the works of the Lord: * sought out according to all his wills.

  2. His work is praise and majesty: * and his justice endures for ever and ever.
  3. He has made a remembrance of his wondrous works, † merciful and compassionate is the Lord: * he has given food to those who fear him.
  4. He will be mindful of his covenant for ever: * he will declare to his people the power of his works:
  5. That he may give them the inheritance of the nations: * the works of his hands are truth and judgment.
  6. All his commandments are faithful: † confirmed for ever and ever, * made in truth and equity.
  7. He has sent redemption to his people: * he has commanded his covenant for ever.
  8. Holy and terrible is his name: * the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
  9. A good understanding have all those who do it: * his praise endures for ever.
  10. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation:
In the heavenly realms//is the dwelling of the saints, alleluia;
and their rest is for ever, alleluia.
In secret your Saints cried out, O Lord: alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
_Ps. 111_  Blessed is the man who fears the Lord: who greatly delights//in his commandments.

blocks.text:
1. Potens in terra erit semen eius: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.
  2. Glória, et divítiæ in domo eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
  3. Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus.
  4. Jucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, † dispónet sermónes suos in iudício: * quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.
  5. In memória ætérna erit iustus: * ab auditióne mala non timébit.
  6. Parátum cor eius speráre in Dómino, † confirmátum est cor eius: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.
  7. Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: † iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu eius exaltábitur in glória.
  8. Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, † déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.
  9. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  10. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. His offspring shall be mighty upon the earth: * the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
  2. Glory and riches shall be in his house: * and his righteousness endures for ever and ever.
  3. A light has risen in the darkness for the upright: * he is merciful, compassionate, and just.
  4. Happy is the man who shows mercy and lends; † he shall order his affairs with judgment: * for he shall never be moved.
  5. The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance: * he shall not fear evil tidings.
  6. His heart is ready to trust in the Lord; † his heart is steadfast: * he shall not be moved until he looks down upon his enemies.
  7. He has distributed freely, he has given to the poor; † his righteousness endures for ever and ever; * his horn shall be exalted in glory.
  8. The sinner shall see it and be angry; † he shall gnash his teeth and waste away: * the desire of sinners shall perish.
  9. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: In secret your Saints cried out, O Lord: alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
Spirits and souls of the just, sing a hymn to our God, alleluia, alleluia.
_Ps. 125_  When the Lord restored the captivity of Sion, we became//like those who are comforted.

blocks.text:
1. Tunc replétum est gáudio os nostrum: * et lingua nostra exsultatióne.
  2. Tunc dicent inter Gentes: * Magnificávit Dóminus fácere cum eis.
  3. Magnificávit Dóminus fácere nobíscum: * facti sumus lætántes.
  4. Convérte, Dómine, captivitátem nostram, * sicut torrens in austro.
  5. Qui séminant in lácrimis, * in exsultatióne metent.
  6. Eúntes ibant et flebant, * mitténtes sémina sua.
  7. Veniéntes autem vénient cum exsultatióne, * portántes manípulos suos.
  8. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  9. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. Then our mouth was filled with joy, * and our tongue with rejoicing.
  2. Then shall they say among the nations: * The Lord has done great things for them.
  3. The Lord has done great things for us: * and we are filled with gladness.
  4. Restore, O Lord, our captivity, * like a torrent in the south.
  5. Those who sow in tears * shall reap in rejoicing.
  6. Going forth, they went and wept, * carrying their seed to sow.
  7. But coming, they shall come with rejoicing, * carrying their sheaves.
  8. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Spirits and souls of the just, sing a hymn to our God, alleluia, alleluia.
The righteous shall shine like the sun//in the sight of God, alleluia.
_Ps. 115_  I believed, therefore I spoke; but I was greatly humbled.

blocks.text:
1. Ego dixi in excéssu meo: * Omnis homo mendax.
  2. Quid retríbuam Dómino, * pro ómnibus, quæ retríbuit mihi?
  3. Cálicem salutáris accípiam: * et nomen Dómini invocábo.
  4. Vota mea Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo ejus: * pretiósa in conspéctu Dómini mors sanctórum ejus:
  5. O Dómine, quia ego servus tuus: * ego servus tuus, et fílius ancíllæ tuæ.
  6. Dirupísti víncula mea: † tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis, * et nomen Dómini invocábo.
  7. Vota mea Dómino reddam in conspéctu omnis pópuli ejus: * in átriis domus Dómini, in médio tui, Jerúsalem.
  8. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  9. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. I said in my alarm: * Every man is a liar.
  2. What shall I render to the Lord * for all that he has rendered to me?
  3. I will take the cup of salvation * and call upon the name of the Lord.
  4. I will pay my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people: * precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.
  5. O Lord, for I am your servant: * I am your servant and the son of your handmaid.
  6. You have broken my bonds: † to you I will offer the sacrifice of praise, * and I will call upon the name of the Lord.
  7. I will pay my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people: * in the courts of the house of the Lord, in the midst of you, O Jerusalem.
  8. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: The righteous shall shine like the sun in the sight of God, alleluia.

The souls of the righteous are in the hand of God, and the torment of death shall not touch them.
They seemed, in the eyes of the foolish, to die; but they are in peace.
\R. Thanks be to God.

blocks.text:
Rex glorióse Mártyrum,
Coróna confiténtium,
Qui respuéntes térrea
Perdúcis ad cæléstia,

Aurem benígnam prótinus
Appóne nostris vócibus:
Trophǽa sacra pángimus,
Ignósce quod delíquimus.

Tu vincis in Martýribus
Parcéndo Confessóribus:
Tu vince nostra crímina
Donándo indulgéntiam.

Glória tibi Dómine,
Qui surrexísti a mórtuis,
Cum Patre et Sancto Spíritu
In sempitérna sǽcula. Amen.
blocks.translation:
O glorious King of martyrs,
crown of confessors,
you who lead to heavenly things
those who spurn the things of earth,

Quickly incline your gracious ear
to our prayers:
we sing your sacred triumphs,
forgive the sins we have committed.

You conquer in your martyrs
by sparing your confessors;
so conquer now our sins
by granting us your mercy.

Glory be to you, O Lord,
who rose from the dead,
with the Father and the Holy Spirit
for everlasting ages. Amen.

blocks.chantTranslation:
℣. The Saints shall exult in glory.
℟. They shall rejoice//in their resting places.

Saints and just, rejoice in the Lord, alleluia;
God has chosen you for an inheritance for himself, alleluia.

blocks.text:
1. Magníficat *  All sit ánima mea Dóminum.
  2. Et exsultávit spíritus meus * in Deo salutári meo.
  3. Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
  4. Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.
  5. Et misericórdia eius a progénie in progénies * timéntibus eum.
  6. Fecit poténtiam in bráchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
  7. Depósuit poténtes de sede, * et exaltávit húmiles.
  8. Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.
  9. Suscépit Israël púerum suum, * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.
  10. Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros, * Abraham et sémini eius in sǽcula.
  11. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  12. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. My soul * magnifies the Lord.
  2. And my spirit has rejoiced * in God my Saviour.
  3. For he has regarded the humility of his handmaid; * for behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
  4. For he that is mighty has done great things to me; * and holy is his name.
  5. And his mercy is from generation unto generations * to those who fear him.
  6. He has shown strength with his arm; * he has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
  7. He has put down the mighty from their seat, * and has exalted the humble.
  8. He has filled the hungry with good things; * and the rich he has sent away empty.
  9. He has helped his servant Israel, * being mindful of his mercy.
  10. As he spoke to our fathers, * to Abraham and to his seed for ever.
  11. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation:
Saints and just, rejoice in the Lord, alleluia;
God has chosen you for an inheritance for himself, alleluia.

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. The Lord be with you.//\R. And with your spirit. \V. Let us pray.
Grant, we beseech you, almighty God,
that we who celebrate the solemnity
of your blessed Martyrs//John and Thomas
may be helped by//their intercession before you.
Through Our Lord Jesus Christ...
\R. Amen.
\V. The Lord be with you.//\R. And with your spirit.

\V. Let us bless the Lord.
\R. Thanks be to God.

blocks.text: The officiant continues in a low voice:

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God,//rest in peace.
\R. Amen.
